WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
),
customer_base AS (
    SELECT c_customer_sk, c_last_name, c_first_name
    FROM customer
),
store_set AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN filtered_dates ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = filtered_dates.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_base ON store_sales.ss_customer_sk = customer_base.c_customer_sk
),
catalog_set AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN filtered_dates ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = filtered_dates.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_base ON catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk = customer_base.c_customer_sk
),
web_set AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN filtered_dates ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = filtered_dates.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_base ON web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk = customer_base.c_customer_sk
),
all_channels AS (
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date, 'store' AS channel FROM store_set
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date, 'catalog' AS channel FROM catalog_set
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date, 'web' AS channel FROM web_set
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    FROM all_channels
    GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT channel) = 3
) AS hot_cust
LIMIT 100
